messages.subject: [R--gR] Hierarchical Multi-Label Classification
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

Thanks in advance.

I am using R-3.0.1 on Windows XP.

May I request you to assist me for the following please.

I have a project to deal with "Hierarchical Multi-Label Classification".

The inputs variables are X: x1, x2, ..., xn and the target variables are C:
c1, c2, ..., cm (e.g., class variables).

The inputs variables may be either discrete or numeric (integer or
continuous) or both.

The target variables (e.g., class variables) take values either 0 or 1.

I am looking for a model or models for this problem.
1. - My objective is to predict class variables C for given inputs X
    - I am also interested to know the hierarchies in the class variables
(e.g., c6 <--- c1 <--- c2, c5; c10 <--- c3, c9, c10

2. Is there any Bayesian Model(s) for this?

3. I like to know other model(s) as well.

4. Any R package(s). I like to know other softwares as well.

5. Any literature would be appreciated

Once again, thank you very much for the time you have given.

Regards,
Deb
